description: Bundled connection covering several remaining advisor-flagged gaps before writing the 08-02/08-03 lessons, all using the empty &LIB2 sandbox: (1) compile the FULL, current src/qrpglesrc/f0803s.rpgle seed and solutions/08-03/f0803s.rpgle solution (as whole, assembled files - not the isolated snippets part08-03-f0803-compile tested) and CALL both with a real customer code, (2) test the actual command a learner typing at a real PASE bsh login prompt would run (export PATH; makei --version) - every prior makei success used bash, never bsh, and P08 established bsh is the real default shell a learner lands in, (3) test 08-02's planned 'add a PF' exercise: a Rules.mk '.FILE: .pf' rule, delivered via python3 binary-mode writes (not heredoc) to avoid the established EBCDIC-corruption trap. Cleans up all created objects afterward.

steps.label: BSHTEST
steps.cmd:
ls -la /usr/bin/bsh /QOpenSys/usr/bin/bsh </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---BSH-DEFAULT-PATH---
/usr/bin/bsh -c 'echo $PATH' </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---BSH-MAKEI-VERSION---
/usr/bin/bsh -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; echo PATH=$PATH; makei --version' </dev/null 2>&1

steps.label: PFEXERCISE
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mkpf"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mkpf/z"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB2.LIB/QDDSSRC.FILE/TESTPF.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mkpf/z/testpf.pf') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mkpf/z/Rules.mk','wb').write(b'TESTPF.FILE: testpf.pf\n')"
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "open('$HOME/mkpf/z/iproj.json','wb').write(b'{\"version\":\"0.0.1\",\"objlib\":\"&LIB2\",\"curlib\":\"&LIB2\"}')"
echo ---BUILD---
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'cd "$HOME/mkpf/z" && export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/makei build' </dev/null 2>&1
echo ---CLEANUP---
system "DLTF FILE(&LIB2/TESTPF)" 2>&1
rm -rf "$HOME/mkpf"

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT * FROM QSYS2.SYSPARMS WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'QSYS2' AND SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GENERATE_SQL' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
